Package com.csse3200.game.components.player

Class ShopComponent

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.Component
com.csse3200.game.components.player.ShopComponent
public class ShopComponent extends Component
A player component that owns shop catalogs and buy/sell transactions.

Does not store gold or player items. Payments use the sibling InventoryComponent on the same entity.

Item purchases deduct gold only when the copied product fits in full. A successful item buy consumes that item listing (one-use offer) and triggers shopChanged. Selling uses the player inventory; a matching BUY listing is only used for price and is not consumed. Upgrade and pet purchases trigger upgradePurchased and petPurchased and leave those listings in place.

    • buyItem

      public boolean buyItem(int catalogSlot)
      Buys the item in a catalog slot using the sibling inventory wallet and slots.

      Gold is deducted only after the copied item fits in full (InventoryComponent.canFullyAdd(Item)). Occupied inventories can still succeed when the product stacks into an existing slot.

      Parameters:
      catalogSlot - item catalog slot
      Returns:
      true if gold was deducted, a copy of the item was added with no leftover, and the selected listing was removed

    • getSellPrice

      public int getSellPrice(Item item)
      Returns the gold refund for selling item.

      If a BUY listing still matches by name and ItemType, that listing's sell price is used. Otherwise a default based on quantity is used. A live listing is not required.

      Parameters:
      item - inventory item to price; null returns 0
      Returns:
      sell refund in gold

    • sellItem

      public boolean sellItem(int playerSlot)
      Sells the entire stack in a player inventory slot and refunds getSellPrice(Item).

      Does not require a matching BUY listing and does not change BUY stock.

      Parameters:
      playerSlot - inventory slot on the sibling InventoryComponent
      Returns:
      true if the item was removed and gold was added

    • buyUpgrade

      public boolean buyUpgrade(int catalogSlot)
      Buys the Upgrade in a catalog slot using gold only. Does not use item slots.

      On success, records the purchase and triggers upgradePurchased. The catalog listing stays.

      Parameters:
      catalogSlot - Upgrade catalog slot
      Returns:
      true if gold was deducted and the purchase was recorded

    • buyPet
